title: Conversational Retrieval Chains
summary: This module provides components for building conversational AI systems that retrieve information from documents, including deprecated chains and a recommended function for history-aware document retrieval.

nodes.label: User Input
nodes.title: User's Input Question
nodes.description: The initial question or statement provided by the user.

nodes.label: Chat History
nodes.title: Past Conversation Context
nodes.description: A record of previous turns in the conversation, used to contextualize new queries.

nodes.label: Language Model (LLM)
nodes.title: Large Language Model
nodes.description: A powerful AI model used for understanding, generating text, and rephrasing questions.

nodes.label: Document Retriever
nodes.title: Information Retrieval System
nodes.description: System responsible for fetching relevant documents from a knowledge base.

nodes.label: Vector Store
nodes.title: Semantic Search Store
nodes.description: A specialized database for storing and querying vector embeddings of documents.

nodes.label: Prompt Templates
nodes.title: Structured LLM Instructions
nodes.description: Pre-defined structures for guiding the LLM's behavior and input formatting.

nodes.label: User
nodes.title: End User
nodes.description: The end-user interacting with the conversational system.

nodes.label: ConversationalRetrievalChain
nodes.title: Deprecated Conversational Q&A Chain
nodes.description: A deprecated chain that manages conversational Q&A by rephrasing questions, retrieving documents, and generating answers using an LLM.

nodes.label: ChatVectorDBChain
nodes.title: Deprecated Vector DB Chat Chain
nodes.description: A deprecated chain for conversational Q&A, specifically designed to interact with a vector database for document retrieval.

nodes.label: create_history_aware_retriever
nodes.title: History-Aware Retriever Factory (Recommended)
nodes.description: A recommended function that creates a Runnable to intelligently retrieve documents, rephrasing user questions based on chat history if available.
